sources.snippet: This project uses the You Only Look Once (YOLO) object detection algorithm to implement a digit recognition system. The system is able to detect and classify handwritten digits written on white paper.

sources.snippet: The yolo_HWD+ dataset is composed of images which are produced with the use of HWD+ dataset. Each yolo_HWD+ image has many single digits on one image and each digit is properly annotated (class x_center y_center width height).
